### Changed

* **Security**: Added SSRF protection for scripting Http clients.

### Fixed

* **Content**: Fix serialization of status fields for contents.

### Added

* **Backend**: Search fields. String fields that are added to full text searches with a simple contains search.
* **Frontend**: Add an option to disable to full frontend UI.
* **Frontend**: Increase width of left panel via button.
* **Frontend**: New responsive menu for content fields.
* **Frontend**: New view to view resolved comments also.

**Client apps require a separately hosted Glass Keep server. Web/server and all client versions are 1.0.22.**

## Notes remain visible after import and refresh

- Keeps the current notes when a refresh fails or browser caching runs out of space. Stale responses across imports, view changes and account changes are ignored; closing the import dialog refreshes the current view.
- Invalid responses and empty offline caches no longer claim the account has no notes. Refresh failures show **Retry**. Actual offline

**These are client apps only. You need a running Glass Keep server. Update both the server and native clients to 1.0.21 for the new upload protocol.**

## Reliable large imports

- Imports large notes intact through authenticated, account-scoped 256 KiB chunk uploads, replacing the old 19 MiB per-request barrier. Complete encoded notes may be up to 128 MiB; pictures are not resized, split into other notes or silently dropped.
- Retries transient connection/proxy errors up to five times with backoff. Stable

**These are client apps only. You need a running Glass Keep server to use them.**

## Google Keep import controls and pictures

- Adds clear **Choose Takeout ZIP**, **Choose Takeout folder**, and **Add JSON files and images** buttons in Settings → Import Google Keep across web and native clients. Addresses the follow-up in [issue #37](https://github.com/nikunjsingh93/react-glass-keep/issues/37).
- Select JSON and pictures together, or add missing pictures after selecting JSON without losing your notes. Fo

**These are client apps only. You need a running Glass Keep server to use them.**

## Large Google Keep Takeout imports

- Removes the old 100 MiB eager-import cap for Google Keep. Standard ZIPs up to 2 GiB are indexed with file slices and attachments are read one note at a time into bounded API batches.
- Takeout ZIPs selected through **Import backup** open the correct **Import Google Keep** dialog before the unrelated 200 MiB backup limit is checked. Addresses [issue #37](https://github.com/nikunjsingh93/

**These are client apps only. You need a running Glass Keep server to use them.**

## German language support

- Adds **Deutsch** on sign-in, native server connection and Settings language pickers across web, Windows, macOS and Android.
- Incorporates all 338 German translations from [piwanowitsch](https://github.com/piwanowitsch) in [PR #35](https://github.com/nikunjsingh93/react-glass-keep/pull/35), with corrected registration, startup/loading text and full integration.
- Saves the language on this device
- Preserves busy feedback, accessible labels and tooltips, Enter to submit and duplicate-submission prevention. Long translated labels truncate within the available space to leave room for search.

**These are client apps only. You need a running Glass Keep server to use them.**

## Russian language support

- Adds **Русский** to the language picker on sign-in, native server connection and Settings screens.
- Includes 338 translated interface strings: notes, tags, settings, imports/exports, sharing, administration, offline controls and the latest account-wide AI messages.
- Saves your language on this device, with translations bundled for offline use. Startup and loading screens also show Russi

**These are client apps only. You need a running Glass Keep server to use them.**

## Android drawers

- Settings and the left tags panel respect the status bar, bottom navigation bar and side safe areas. Titles and close controls stay visible while panel content scrolls independently.
- Android Back closes Settings or tags instead of exiting the app. Nested confirmations close first; existing note editing and unsaved-change handling are preserved.
- Hidden drawers no longer leave a strip visible beside a l

**These are client apps only. You need a running Glass Keep server to use them.**

## One version across all platforms

Web, server, Windows, macOS and Android are all **1.0.14**, including embedded application metadata. A shared version command and native build check keep future releases aligned. This release includes the visible Ask AI button and all earlier improvements.

## Account-wide AI setting

- Enable AI once for your account and it becomes available on your other devices connected to the same ser

Browser checks cover visible/disabled button states, clicking to submit, Enter, duplicate prevention, busy feedback, source-note navigation and cancellation on both web and native IPC. Button layout is checked at 320, 390 and 768 pixels; native header/offline/export and translation regressions pass. Both frontend builds pass, and Docker checks verify both architectures.
